name: neo-bot
description: A clean-room, modular Telegram VPN sales bot foundation.

scripts.check: pnpm context:check && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm architecture && pnpm test && pnpm test:deploy-cli
scripts.local-test:up: docker compose -p neo_bot_local_test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-test.yml --profile app up -d --build
scripts.local-test:down: docker compose -p neo_bot_local_test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-test.yml --profile app down
scripts.local-test:status: docker compose -p neo_bot_local_test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-test.yml --profile app ps
scripts.local-test:logs: docker compose -p neo_bot_local_test -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-test.yml --profile app logs --tail=100 -f
